description.zh: 客户端ID列表。客户端ID数量不能超过100个。
description.en: A list of client IDs. The list can contain up to 100 client IDs.

descriptions.zh: 不删除备份客户端，仅删除备份客户端的所属资源，包括备份计划、备份任务、快照。
descriptions.en: This operation does not delete the backup client. It only deletes the resources of the backup client, such as backup plans, backup jobs, and snapshots.
